Interface EnchantmentType

All Superinterfaces:
ComponentLike, DefaultedRegistryValue<EnchantmentType>, Taggable<EnchantmentType>
@CatalogedBy(EnchantmentTypes.class) public interface EnchantmentType extends DefaultedRegistryValue<EnchantmentType>, ComponentLike, Taggable<EnchantmentType>
Represents a modifier on an item that has various effects.

  • Method Details

    • weight

      int weight()
      Gets the weight of this enchantment type.

      Higher values are more common. This value is also used in the repair cost calculation.

      Returns:
      The weight of this enchantment type

    • isTreasure

      default boolean isTreasure()
      Gets whether or not this enchantment type is considered a "treasure" enchantment.

      These do not occur naturally in enchantment tables.

      Returns:
